comparison.objective: Remove an internal obstruction, then re-thread and fully close a jar lid; candidate finishes HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual unscrewing, emptying, thread engagement, and torque limitation versus small-bore coaxial mandrel use, hammering, and fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Block removed and lid seated without forcing above 0.6 N·m or toppling the jar versus four valid tang fractures without coil displacement, shell damage, jamming, or fragment loss.
comparison.reason: Although both protect threaded hardware from overload, jar obstruction diagnosis and screw closure do not test impact fracture at manufactured notches or loose-tang accounting.
